sections.content: A community meeting requires speakers to introduce proposals, respond to other ideas and explain priorities. Proponer *que*, sugerir que, estar de *acuerdo* con and no estar de acuerdo con allow speakers to move from an individual opinion towards discussion and negotiation.

items.spanish: Propongo que reduzcamos el tráfico en el centro.
items.english: I propose that we reduce traffic in the centre.

items.spanish: Estoy de acuerdo con que se construya un nuevo parque.
items.english: I agree that a new park should be built.

items.spanish: No estoy de acuerdo con que se eliminen todas las plazas de aparcamiento.
items.english: I do not agree with removing all the parking spaces.

items.spanish: Sugiero que primero acordemos qué problema queremos resolver.
items.english: I suggest that we first agree on which problem we want to solve.

sections.content: Discussion language should respond to another position. A useful proposal can include the action, a reason and a possible consequence.
